title: POST /game-api/s2s-api/v1.0/lobby/rooms/remove
$comment: Observed on 1.8.0.13 on a clean RCON `shutdown`: 200, 15 bytes, and again a plain GET /game-api/api/v1.0/dummy immediately before it. This is the unregister: after it the server is out of the browser. A server that is killed rather than shut down does not send it, and the room then disappears on its own.

request.description: This is the request shape every room-scoped call shares - the five fields of $defs/roomCaller in common.schema.json - with nothing added.
